products.title: Wassily Chair: Reimagined
products.description:
Wassily Chair: Reimagined

Originally designed by Marcel Breuer in 1925, the Wassily Chair is a timeless icon of modernist design. Our rendition pays homage to the master’s vision (precise, structural, and undeniably bold) while introducing a contemporary twist.

Crafted with a black powder-coated metal frame and finished in rich saddle tan leather, this version brings warmth to the original’s industrial clarity. The interplay of tension and openness remains, but the new palette lends it a more grounded, earthy presence, a subtle shift that honors history while speaking to the present.

Every line, proportion, and angle remains faithful to Breuer’s original innovation, a true ode to Bauhaus mastery, reinterpreted with respect and character.

Dimensions

Height: 28–29"

Width: 30–31"

Depth: 27–28"

Seat Height: 16–17"

Arm Height: 23"

Materials

Powder-Coated Metal Frame (Black)

Saddle Tan Leather Straps

products.title: Terrazzo Reimagined Tray
products.description:
It’s easy to take a material for granted. Assume that it can only do what we’ve always seen it be used for. However, here at Quadko, we spend countless hours reimagining how materials can be mixed, layered and repurposed for different design concepts.

Thus we’re very happy to share with you our first Collectible design series – Reimagined. The first of the series is our take on Terrazzo.

Dating as far back as the Egyptian era and relatively more recently revived by it’s Italian forefathers, this composite material is a staple from everyone’s childhood memories.

The reimagined Terrazzo series consists of small batches of trays and coasters. 

The trays are made of layers of different shaped pieces, which were individually cut and then thoughtfully placed into custom moulds. Once the final pour was completed, each item was individually hand polished to create a piece that can truly never be replicated again.

Due to the cost of materials, wastage and craftsmanship required, our collectible series will always be limited, allowing you to own a piece of Pakistani design history.

Grab yours today, before they run out!

Materials: 

Resin
Wood

Dimensions: 9"x18"

products.title: Classic Golpie
products.description:
The Golpai is our ode to the centuries-old sub-continental charpai. The Golpai has been designed to be less wide than a traditional charpai but wider than a traditional chair, the Golpai offers a practical solution to your lazy Sunday lounging needs. This design is similar to our Backed Golpie, however, this variation does not have a back.

The Golpai brings an updated contemporary design and rounded edges. Made from solid pinewood and locally sourced cordage, the Golpai features updated geometric weave patterns,

This product is made to order and can be color customized as per your need.

Materials:

Solid sprucewood
Deco paint
Mixed cotton cordage.
